SealedSeatAssignment.title: SealedSeatAssignment
SealedSeatAssignment.description: The sealed seat assignment: immutable binding of one principal to one seat of one W023 entitlement grant, plus the SHA-256 content digest (the exact-revision content address).

SeatAssignmentId.title: SeatAssignmentId
SeatAssignmentId.description: Opaque seat-assignment identity: "seat:" followed by a lowercase slug.

EntitlementId.title: EntitlementId
EntitlementId.description: Opaque entitlement identity: "entitlement:" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
